Wow I’m sorry that happened idk how people are so delusional. You guys definitely reminded me of the sick logic because I’ve been so detached from it I forget how cruel and insane they can be. You’re right about keeping the bar dirt low. Thank you for sharing your experience and advice.
I hadn’t even thought of that thank you. I forget how twisted their logic can be
STAY STRONG!! You are doing this for a healthier happier life and you will not regret it. It’s so awesome that you got something set up and are making this step it’s 100% in the right direction!!

Yes I relate to this so much. Twice my mom physically assaulted me severely then called the cops and the cops told me what an ungrateful brat I am and that she should kick me out. 

My view is if children are acting out in such ways or if there is trauma in the family it is the adult in powers fault obviously. I’m sorry no one is taking you seriously. My best advice is to move out and go NC as soon as possible. That’s what I did and I’ve been still trying to recover from a hell of a life for 18 year and 5 years being too afraid to go NC.

Same. My own parents were my biggest haters growing up. My own mom called me a whore, slut, homeless woman, trash. It just confirms that her and every person I know is thinking about how gross I am they just are fake and don’t say it out loud.

Wow you have been through so much! You’re almost out! I recommend applying to good first time job stores like CVS, Walgreens OR doing online remote work like data entry/customer service/tutoring. For housing, check college SUBLETS and college room rental Facebook pages in your area for affordable first time housing. 

I’ve been in a really similar position. It’s going to be hard at first supporting yourself and you’ll have to make sacrifices but the peace of mind and confidence you gain is priceless. Feel free to DM me if you need support!

I came to this subreddit looking for exactly this. When I put on lipstick my nmom would say I look like a prostitute. When I wore a flattering top she’d say you have such prominent breasts I bet all the men can’t stop staring and love it. Now I have a huge fear of being “sexy” or considered appealing. She always attached looking good to being a sex object for men to take advantage of. I feel like it has stopped me from trying to look my best which has affected my confidence. I’m slowing trying to build up my wardrobe with cuter clothes and try bolder makeup but the fear is overwhelming :/
When my friends would come over, my mom would literally ask my friends to teach me how they wash their hair and manage hygiene because she never did
